Perfect Pick is a goods-to-person automated storage and retrieval system (AS/RS) from OPEX Corporation that uses the company's iBOT mobile robots to retrieve bins from dense storage and bring them to pick or put stations, maximizing storage density and order-fulfillment throughput. OPEX exhibited its warehouse automation lineup, including Perfect Pick, at LogiMAT 2026.

Sure Sort is an automated robotic parcel- and item-sorting system from OPEX Corporation that reduces manual sorting labor and adapts its sort profile to changing warehouse needs. OPEX exhibited the Sure Sort lineup, alongside the Sure Sort X variant, at LogiMAT 2026.

The ZS-H125 is a 20-wheeled, ultra-low-profile four-way pallet shuttle from Shanghai-based ZS Robotics, built for high-density automated pallet storage in warehouses. It is 125 mm tall, carries a 1,500 kg rated load, weighs 310 kg, reaches 1.5 m/s and runs 8-10 hours on a 48V/50Ah battery across a -25C to 50C operating range; ZS Robotics showed its four-way shuttle lineup at LogiMAT 2026.

Monumental builds and operates a fleet of autonomous dual-arm bricklaying robots that lay brick and mortar on live construction sites, with one arm placing bricks and the other extruding mortar through a nozzle that adjusts vibration and extrusion in real time. The Amsterdam-based startup, founded in 2021 by former Palantir engineers, guides the robots with its own Atrium software stack and fixed site-reference sensors, and has used a fleet of 100+ robots to build walls for more than 150 homes across the Netherlands and UK, raising a 32 million USD Series B in 2026 to expand into the US.

ASCEND is a tower crane-mounted robotic 3D concrete printing platform from Melbourne-based Luyten, billed as the world's first such system. It integrates concrete extrusion into standard tower-crane architecture already used on high-rise jobsites, printing up to 100 m tall over a 45 m working radius with AI-generated print paths and Luyten's own Ultimatecrete printable concrete mix; it installs in 1-2 days and was launched in June 2026.

The 3K is a vision-driven AI cooking robot from Xianglu Robotics that uses three 40-megapixel global-shutter cameras at 30 fps, paired with the company's CookingMuse cooking-AI model, to read ingredient moisture, temperature and doneness in real time and adjust heat, timing, stirring speed and seasoning accordingly rather than following fixed recipe parameters. It was demonstrated cooking dishes such as mapo tofu and stir-fried pork with peppers at the World Robot Conference 2026, adapting mid-cook to ingredient changes.

RobotCook is a mobile, self-contained kitchen robot from Xianglu Robotics that integrates ingredient storage, embodied-AI cooking, serving, exhaust treatment and self-cleaning in one unit, able to cook two dishes at once. It is designed to be deployed at exhibitions, sporting events and office parks without needing a fixed restaurant kitchen, and was shown at the World Robot Conference 2026.
The Dolphin W20 is a commercial robotic pool cleaner built for apartment-complex and condominium pools, offering heavy-duty cleaning for shared and semi-commercial installations.
The Dolphin Wave 60 is a commercial-grade robotic pool cleaner in the Wave series, aimed at apartment-complex and condo pools.

RoboWeeder F50 is a tractor-towed AI weeding, thinning and spraying implement from Niqo Robotics, unveiled in October 2026 as North America's widest hooded AI weeder for large specialty-crop and turf farms. It has a 46-foot working width extendable to 50 feet across five bays carrying 14 Niqo Sense AI cameras and a 350-nozzle array, weighs about 4,900 lb (2,200 kg), travels up to 4.7 mph (7.5 km/h) covering up to 25 acres per hour, and needs a 135+ hp tractor; Niqo is taking orders for delivery for the 2027 season.

ZEISS TALOS is an automated optical 3D metrology robot cell for large, complex parts, pairing a robotic arm with the integrated ZEISS TALOS AX blue-light sensor so it needs no external tracking markers. It measures with better than 100 micron uncertainty using a 24-megapixel, 100 Hz camera over a 3.30 m reach and up to 5000 mm part size, is offline-programmed from CAD in ZEISS INSPECT software, and targets automotive, aerospace and heavy-vehicle inspection; Audi is an early adopter.

Forefront Concept is an electric unmanned ground vehicle co-developed by Renault Group and Belgian defense group John Cockerill, unveiled on 3 November 2026 for both defense and civilian missions. It uses four-wheel drive and four-wheel steering with two electric motors, carries up to one tonne of payload about 400 km on a charge (extendable with a range extender), and is remotely operated today with autonomous navigation targeted; planned roles include logistics support, ISR, anti-drone work, fire support, casualty evacuation and civil-protection use in hazardous terrain. It remains a concept, with trials alongside French armed forces planned in the following weeks.

description: Automatic IV compounding robot system from Hangzhou-based MeiLan Pharmaceutical (founded 2019), marketed as the ML300 and on the market since 2025 for hospital PIVAS (pharmacy intravenous admixture service) centers. It combines robotics, electrical automation, AI, magnetic levitation and precision measurement/control in an 8-12 sq m footprint to automate the workflow from order receipt through drug sorting, labeling, bottle-opening sterilization, dissolving/mixing, compounding review and medical-waste disposal, at 3-15 times a pharmacist's manual speed with full video traceability. It was validated over two years at Peking University Third Hospital and Tianjin Cancer Hospital, and a unit built by the company's North China Innovation Center passed operational testing in Beijing's Mentougou district on 6 November 2026.

Prismind L is a pipe and cylinder-bore inner-wall inspection robot series from Xi'an-based industrial-AI firm GLASSSIX (第六镜科技), launched on 8 July 2026 at a product event in Xi'an's high-tech zone and shown at ADIPEC 2026 in Abu Dhabi. It combines a robot body, high-precision vision sensors and a 2D+3D composite imaging system to navigate autonomously inside dark, oily, narrow pipes and hydraulic-cylinder bores, using 3D point-cloud and 2D image fusion to detect corrosion pits, scratches and other surface defects at up to 0.05 mm measurement precision and auto-generate inspection reports; it targets steel, metallurgy and aerospace tube/cylinder inspection and has been validated in real cylinder-bore inspection deployments.

A jointly developed automatic drilling robot from elevator maker Otis and Lenovo, unveiled in November 2026 at the China International Import Expo to automate guide-rail and landing-door drilling inside elevator shafts after the shaft concrete has set, cutting workers' exposure to dust and fall hazards. It combines Otis' elevator-installation engineering with Lenovo's AI, computing and industrial-robotics technology, with first deployment planned at the Tianjin 117 Tower project, where Otis is supplying 266 units including the world's highest-lift elevator.

FD140 is an automated forklift robot in Quicktron's F-Series, using SLAM and QR-code navigation to transfer standard racks and pallets at up to 1400 kg rated load with +/-10 mm positioning accuracy, aimed at inbound/outbound warehouse logistics.

C150A is a four-way shuttle AMR in Quicktron's C-Series used for high-density vertical pallet storage. At only 120 mm tall, Quicktron calls it the industry's thinnest four-way shuttle; it moves at up to 2 m/s, handles 0.8-1.4 m pallets, is CE certified, and operates across a -15 to 45 degC range for 24/7 warehouse use.

ALPAR is a heavy-class tracked unmanned armoured ground vehicle developed by Turkish manufacturer Otokar for manned-unmanned teaming on the battlefield, aiming to take over routine tasks and reduce personnel risk using onboard AI and autonomous-driving systems. It has a maximum loaded weight of 15 tons and was unveiled alongside Otokar's other armoured-vehicle programs ahead of IDEF 2023.

Shadow Rider is a family of modular, optionally-manned unmanned ground vehicles made by Turkish armoured-vehicle manufacturer FNSS (a joint venture between Nurol and BAE Systems), built on the combat-proven M113 personnel-carrier chassis. It can be driven remotely, autonomously or by an onboard crew, operates in GNSS-denied areas with an AI-based autonomy kit and 360-degree detection, and comes in five mission variants (Command, Tactical Decoy, Fire Support, Engineering Reconnaissance and Logistics Support) carrying up to 4,500kg of payload; the prototype was unveiled at IDEF 2021 in Istanbul after being shown as a concept at IDEF 2019.

TruckBot is an autonomous trailer and container unloading robot from Mujin, a robotics software company founded in Tokyo. A stationary robotic arm with pneumatic suction grippers reaches up to 52 feet into a trailer from an integrated conveyor to unload mixed-SKU boxes up to 50 lb, processing up to roughly 1,000 boxes per hour. It was introduced at ProMat 2023.

H1 is a dual-arm button-mushroom harvesting robot from Chinese company QiO Robotics (启物科技, also reported in trade press as INSPIREOMNI), headquartered in Beijing with manufacturing in Zhangzhou. It combines a mobile base, elevating mast and dexterous end-effectors with the company's on-device QiO Brain vision-language-action AI, and the maker reports 99% recognition accuracy, 95% pick success, under 5% damage rate and average throughput of 25 mushrooms/minute (about 28.8 kg/h, peak 43.2 kg/h).

PAL Ready is a fully assembled, pre-configured robotic palletizing cell from Robotiq, a Quebec-based cobot accessory maker. It handles payloads up to 35 kg, is designed for one-day installation, and can be redeployed to a new location in under 10 minutes without anchoring.

SPAD 200B is a mobile ground support station from Brazilian drone maker XMobots that autonomously mixes, loads and services two DJI Agras spraying drones in parallel from a single trailer. It carries 1,000 L of water and 1,000 L of agrochemical inputs, weighs 1,900 kg empty, and includes an integrated weather station, RTK positioning and satellite communication, enabling about 200 hectares of coverage in four hours with one pilot and one ground operator.

Nauru 1000C ISTAR is a hybrid-propulsion fixed-wing VTOL surveillance drone made by Brazilian manufacturer XMobots, used by the Brazilian Army for border monitoring. It has a 7.7 m wingspan, 181 kg maximum takeoff weight, carries up to 42 kg payload including an electro-optical/infrared gimbal, and flies up to 10 hours at a 60-knot cruise speed.

Botmy Coffee is an autonomous robotic coffee kiosk made by Argentine automation firm BotMy Solutions SRL, described on its own site as the first robotized coffee of Latin America. It prepares drinks in about 120 seconds, serves 30-40 beverages per hour from a 9 m2 footprint with an 18.5-inch contactless-payment touchscreen kiosk, and is deployed at Universidad de Palermo and Abasto Shopping in Buenos Aires, with an airport location planned next.

T-BOT is an autonomous ground inspection robot designed and manufactured by Treffer, a Brazilian robotics and automation company based in Minas Gerais and designated a Strategic Defense Enterprise by Brazil's Ministry of Defense. It is built for inspection and operational security in critical environments and can be teleoperated, and it took part in Brazilian Navy operational trials at Furnas in 2026.

description: Tethys One is an autonomous underwater inspection drone made by Tethys Robotics, a Swiss ETH Zurich spin-off, for structural inspection of submerged assets in rivers, tidal currents and offshore sites. It weighs 35 kg, is rated to 300 m depth, holds position in currents up to 3.5 knots, and runs about 4 hours per charge on hot-swappable batteries; Brazilian distributor Treffer has used it to inspect submarine structures at Germany's Riffgat offshore wind farm.

Harpia P-71 is an autonomous agricultural spraying drone from Brazilian company Psyche Aerospace, specified with a 400-liter tank for liquid or solid agrochemicals, a 280 kg carbon-and-aluminum airframe, about 40 hectares-per-hour coverage and roughly 1 hour of flight per charge; the company markets it as the world's largest agricultural drone. It first flew in March 2024, but Brazilian media (G1, CompreRural, Dec 2025) reported the aircraft still had not reached operational flight status after the company laid off about 130 staff in May 2025 when the project stalled.

Harpia Hexa is a hexacopter agricultural spraying drone from Brazilian maker Psyche Aerospace, carrying a 400-liter liquid tank with precision nozzles for variable flow and droplet-size control. It weighs about 300 kg, flies roughly 90 minutes per charge, and covers about 48 hectares per hour.

Carcara is a solar-assisted fixed-wing surveillance drone from Psyche Aerospace of Brazil, built for round-the-clock monitoring of farmland for fires, trespassing and field incidents. It carries an EO/IR gimbal with 4K zoom, radiometric thermal imaging and a laser rangefinder, weighs 24.9 kg, and covers about 400 hectares per hour at up to 120 m altitude.

Golias is a wheeled agricultural rover from Psyche Aerospace of Brazil built to collect soil samples and run multispectral analysis across fields, measuring moisture, conductivity, nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, pH and temperature. It weighs about 110 kg and uses a carbon-and-aluminum frame with a Codesys-based control system.

Sabia is a solar-assisted fixed-wing mapping drone from Brazilian maker Psyche Aerospace, built for continuous aerial data collection over farmland. It carries a multispectral RGB/infrared/red-edge sensor for NDVI crop-health mapping, weighs 15 kg, and covers about 125 hectares per hour at up to 120 m altitude.

Tatu is a compact tracked ground robot from Psyche Aerospace of Brazil that collects soil samples and runs a 7-in-1 sensor analysis of moisture, conductivity, nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium, pH and temperature. Its tracked drive minimizes soil compaction, it weighs 80 kg, and it relays data over a 30 km LoRa link.

Forest.Bot is a fully electric autonomous planting robot made by Brazilian company AutoAgroMachines for large-scale reforestation and commercial silviculture. It plants up to 1,800 tree seedlings per hour using a patented sliding mechanism that avoids dragging or misaligning seedlings, with AI-based quality monitoring and georeferenced mapping of planted rows.

AcaiBot is a climbing harvesting robot made by Brazilian agtech Kaatech of Belem, Para, that grips and ascends acai and jucara palm trunks (50-150 cm in diameter) by remote control with AI-assisted features, cutting fruit bunches at the crown and carrying them down in an onboard reservoir holding up to 80 kg. Built from injection-molded plastic and carbon fiber, it was adapted from Amazonian acai harvesting for Atlantic Forest jucara palms and was first deployed for that use with the Dom Tomas Balduino MST community in Parana in June 2026.

description: Otter is a lightweight, portable unmanned surface vehicle (USV) made by Norway's Maritime Robotics for shallow-water bathymetric and hydrographic surveys, environmental monitoring and harbour security. It is an all-electric catamaran with a 62 kg dry weight, 30 kg payload capacity, 4.5-knot top speed and up to 20 hours endurance, controlled via the manufacturer's Vehicle Control Station for remote or autonomous waypoint navigation.

Otter X is a fully electric catamaran USV from Maritime Robotics engineered for challenging coastal and river operations, including bathymetric surveys, environmental monitoring and maritime surveillance. The manufacturer states a dry weight under 1000 kg and overall dimensions of 4600 x 1900 x 2213 mm, with a modular payload bay for sonars, cameras, radar and AIS.

description: Mariner is a 2000 kg unmanned surface vessel from Maritime Robotics built from lightweight polyethylene for offshore and coastal surveillance, pipeline and platform inspection, ROV/AUV support and seabed surveying. The manufacturer states a 24-knot top speed and 400 kg payload capacity, with an optional retractable moonpool elevator for deploying sensors below the hull.

description: Mariner X is Maritime Robotics' largest unmanned surface vessel, a 5000 kg hull designed for long-range defense, hydrographic and offshore-construction-support missions with up to 25 days of fuel endurance. The manufacturer states a 12-knot top speed, 1200 kg payload capacity and two moonpool elevators for launching ROVs/AUVs and other subsea sensors.

Fieldworker 1 is an enhanced autonomous raspberry-harvesting robot from Cambridge-based Fieldwork Robotics, announced in August 2024, offering more accurate AI-driven berry-ripeness detection via spectral-frequency analysis (to remove human bias) and a heightened picking speed matching human pickers. It builds on the company's Innovate UK-backed BerryBot and BerryAI projects, is designed to run in multi-robot fleets supervised by a single operator, and is being trialled on Australian farms through a 2024 collaboration with grower Costa Group.

ARTHUR is an AI-powered, fully autonomous ultrasound robot from Danish medtech firm ROPCA A/S, built to scan finger, hand and wrist joints for arthritis diagnosis and treatment monitoring without a sonographer present. It captures standardized greyscale and Doppler images of up to 15 joints per hand at a stated capacity of 4 patients per hour, is CE-marked and received FDA clearance in 2026; the companion DIANA software turns its scans into structured clinical reports.

MTGR (Micro Tactical Ground Robot) is a lightweight, man-portable tracked ground robot made by Israeli company Roboteam for explosive-ordnance-disposal, special-operations and other tactical missions. It features stair-climbing and self-righting mobility for indoor and outdoor terrain, and has been bought in large numbers by the US Air Force and, from 2024, the US Marine Corps (around 200 units under a roughly 30 million USD program), with final assembly performed in the US at partner Mistral's White Marsh facility.

REX MK II is a multi-mission unmanned ground vehicle developed by Israel Aerospace Industries (IAI) with Germany's FFG through their FTS joint venture, first unveiled in 2021. It supports infantry by autonomously carrying ammunition, medical supplies, water and food and evacuating injured personnel on a stretcher, gathers intelligence with electro-optical sensors and radar, can operate in GPS-denied off-road terrain, and can optionally be equipped with a weapon system; it won Best Scientific Solution at the 2024 European Land Robot Trial (ELROB) in Trier, Germany.

Aslan is a middle-class unmanned ground vehicle made by Turkish defense electronics company ASELSAN for reconnaissance, surveillance and target identification. It is driven by an electric motor, can be remotely operated or run autonomous area-detection missions over demanding terrain (climbing 60% grades and 60cm trenches), and can be fitted with mission payloads such as ASELSAN's SARP-L remote-controlled weapon station, a cargo basket or an elevating observation mast; it was first unveiled at TEKNOFEST Samsun and demonstrated to Turkish security forces at FNSS headquarters in Ankara in November 2021.

Goshawk is a fully autonomous counter-drone interceptor made by Israeli company Robotican for 24/7 airspace protection. It detects, tracks and captures hostile drones using a specialized net effector rather than destroying them, then carries them to a designated area for safe disposal, requiring no piloting skill from its operator and aiming for zero collateral damage. The system completed a live 'Safe Guard' interception demonstration at Israel's Snir national UAV test range in September 2022.

M1.5 is a hybrid unmanned ground vehicle from Dubai-based Micropolis Robotics, unveiled in May 2026 at Make it in the Emirates as an enhanced-capacity evolution of the company's existing M1/M2 robot line. It is built for longer-distance, longer-duration missions over more complex off-road terrain with improved mobility and endurance, developed in response to requirements from customers such as the UAE National Guard and Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Interior for extended-range border-control, remote-surveillance and critical-infrastructure deployments.

Sky2 is an octocopter delivery drone made by Israeli drone-delivery company Flytrex, launched in April 2026 as what the company calls the largest-capacity food-delivery drone available. It carries up to 8.8 lb (about 4 kg), enough for two large pizzas, sides and a drink in one trip, flies a roughly 4-mile delivery radius with an average 4.5-minute takeoff-to-delivery time, and debuted through a Little Caesars partnership in Wylie, Texas, part of Flytrex's US drone-delivery operations that have run in North Texas since 2022.

Xtender is a small quadcopter drone made by Israeli company Xtend for indoor tactical reconnaissance, letting a soldier fly it through tight openings to scout rooms and buildings before entering. The airframe weighs about 1.2 kg and measures roughly 400 x 300 x 100 mm with a protective rotor cage, reaches 12 km/h, flies about 10 minutes per quick-swap battery, and carries a low-light day/night camera; it is operated with VR goggles using Xtend's Mark&Fly hand-gesture control system, requiring only about an hour of training.

Griffon is a counter-drone interceptor made by Israeli company Xtend, the firm's first product after its 2018 founding. It takes off autonomously once cued by third-party detection sensors such as radar, then is manually flown at roughly 150 km/h to catch a hostile drone with a net-like effector that entangles its rotors and causes it to crash, with the effector detaching from the Griffon on impact; over 150 units have been delivered to the US Department of Defense.

The LD-150 is an autonomous mobile robot from Omron Robotics carrying up to 150 kg on a 500 mm-wide footprint, with travel speeds up to 2.1 m/s and wireless inductive charging in 30 minutes or less. It was unveiled for Automate 2026 with shipments planned for Q4 2026.

The LD-300 is an autonomous mobile robot from Omron Robotics rated for up to 300 kg payload on a 580 mm-wide footprint, with travel speeds up to 2.1 m/s and wireless inductive charging in 30 minutes or less. It was unveiled for Automate 2026 with shipments planned for Q4 2026.

Kachaka Evo is a compact autonomous mobile robot from Preferred Robotics rated for up to 100 kg payload. It is designed to pass through narrow aisles and uses a lift-up mechanism so existing cage carts and dollies can be moved without modification, targeting transport automation in manufacturing, warehouses and restaurants. It launched in Japan in October 2026 alongside the smaller Kachaka and Kachaka Pro.

Togrus is a mobile surveillance robot from Tokyo Robotics with a manipulator-mounted camera for remote visual inspection. Deployed with NTT Communications as Togrus-DC, it patrols data centers to inspect server racks remotely.

Tolon is a single-arm mobile manipulator from Tokyo Robotics that pairs an asymmetrical robot arm with an omnidirectional base for operating in narrow spaces. It supports autonomous navigation, image recognition, material handling and patrol tasks, and was sold to R&D customers from 2022.
Mobile Gripper is a transport and palletizing automation robot from Tokyo Robotics that handles heavy loads and open-top plastic containers using a dual-side clamping mechanism.
Precise Omni is a high-precision omnidirectional mobile robot from Tokyo Robotics that uses a geared floor-engagement drive for slip-free, highly accurate movement.

Torobo Puppet is a scaled-down teleoperation interface from Tokyo Robotics that mirrors its movements onto the full-size Torobo humanoid in real time, with force feedback that vibrates when the robot's hands meet resistance. It ships in a seated station version and a wearable version, and is used to collect training data and control Torobo for tasks such as box transport; it is listed as under development.

Thouzer Mini is the smallest model in Doog's Thouzer line of collaborative transport robots, which follow a person, cart or other Thouzer units, trace reflective-tape lines with obstacle detection, or learn and repeat routes via memory tracing.

Thouzer Giant is a large-capacity model in Doog's Thouzer line of collaborative transport robots, which follow a person, cart or other Thouzer units, trace reflective-tape lines with obstacle detection, or learn and repeat routes via memory tracing.

Thouzer Giant4M is the largest model in Doog's Thouzer line of collaborative transport robots, which follow a person, cart or other Thouzer units, trace reflective-tape lines with obstacle detection, or learn and repeat routes via memory tracing.
RoboCar Tractor 25T is an autonomous towing vehicle from ZMP capable of unmanned, driverless towing of loads up to 25 tonnes, aimed at factory and logistics-site cart hauling.
RoboCar AGV 10-200T is a heavy-duty automated guided vehicle line from ZMP engineered to precisely transport loads ranging from 10 to 200 tonnes in factories and logistics facilities.

ugo Ex is a low-cost, highly expandable patrol and inspection robot from Mira Robotics aimed at power plants and facility security monitoring. It carries dual HD cameras with a ring light plus 2D LiDAR, depth and ultrasonic sensors, reaches speeds up to 3.6 km/h, and supports modular sensor mounting via accessory poles.

8WDS Rover is a large prototype transport cart robot from Vstone with all eight wheels independently steered and suspended for highly maneuverable, slip-free movement. Built on the company's research-platform cart-robot line through its Proto Robo prototyping service, it runs on a 24V/1440Wh LiFe battery and was shown at the 2025 International Robot Exhibition.

Misebo is an autonomous retail-inspection robot from Preferred Networks that photographs store shelves with 8 cameras, LiDAR and ToF sensors to flag out-of-stock items, pricing errors and planogram issues while avoiding shoppers during business hours. Built on autonomous-navigation technology from Preferred Robotics' Kachaka, it began trials at Super Center PLANT stores in Fukui in June 2024 ahead of a chain-wide rollout.

OriHime is a small tabletop avatar robot from Ory Laboratory with a built-in camera, microphone and speaker that a remote operator controls over the internet to take part in classrooms, workplaces, weddings and family life they cannot physically attend. It is aimed at hospitalized or home-bound children, people with mobility restrictions, and families separated by distance or care facilities.
M2 is Naver Labs' 3D high-precision mapping robot for creating digital-twin data of indoor spaces, succeeding the original M1 mapping robot from 2016 with upgraded sensors and accuracy.

SeRo is Naver Labs' asset-management automation robot deployed at the GAK Sejong data center, where it loads and unloads server equipment to and from the IT warehouse in coordination with the GaRo transport robot.
GaRo is Naver Labs' autonomous transport robot operating inside the GAK Sejong data center, self-driving server assets between the IT warehouse and server rooms in tandem with the SeRo robot.

ALT-B is Naver Labs' fully driverless autonomous shuttle (the B stands for bus) that ferries people across the large GAK Sejong data center campus, called via kiosk and running on the ALTRIV self-driving software connected to Naver Cloud's ARC multi-robot system.
AMR 1500 is a standard-type autonomous mobile robot from Hanwha Robotics' mobility robot lineup, designed for turnkey warehouse and factory material transport automation.
AMR 350 is a standard-type autonomous mobile robot in Hanwha Robotics' mobility robot lineup, offered as part of its turnkey factory and warehouse automation solutions.

NarGo60 is Twinny's 60 kg-payload autonomous mobile robot for buildings and logistics facilities, navigating complex indoor environments without added infrastructure using 3D and 2D LiDAR, and able to operate elevators and automatic doors.
NarGo100 is Twinny's 100 kg-payload autonomous mobile robot for industrial applications, using infrastructure-free 3D/2D LiDAR navigation with a customizable cargo box.
NarGo500FT is Twinny's pallet-handling autonomous mobile robot for factory automation, using a forklift-style fork to pick up and unload pallets of up to 500 kg (600 kg on its pallet rack).
NarGoD40 is Twinny's indoor delivery robot for multi-floor buildings, able to operate elevators autonomously and carry items on an adjustable-height cargo shelf with automatic locking.

NarGoW100 is Twinny's warehouse picking-assist mobile robot that follows order pickers to automate item transport, integrating with warehouse management systems and compatible with forklift operations.
NarGoF300 is a factory-automation autonomous mobile robot from Twinny, carrying up to 300 kg of material on customized hardware for production-site transport tasks.
NarGoF600 is Twinny's heavy-duty factory automation robot, built to transport up to 600 kg of material autonomously around production environments.
TarGo100 is Twinny's human-following cart robot, recognizing and tracking a target person via an RGB-D camera after a one-touch activation, with no wearable tracking device required.

ANGEL LEGS M20 is Angel Robotics' wearable overground gait-training exoskeleton for people with incomplete lower-limb paralysis, offering seven force-controlled training modes (including sit-to-stand, walking and stair climbing) with motion-intent sensing and KFDA certification.

MW10 is Angel Robotics' suspension-walker frame that straps in a patient and the ANGEL LEGS M20 exoskeleton together to prevent falls and offload body weight, expanding which patients can safely undergo gait-training rehabilitation.

ANGEL SUIT H10 is Angel Robotics' hip-joint assistive wearable robot for post-surgery and mobility rehabilitation, delivering up to 15 Nm of independently adjustable per-side torque via real-time motion recognition, with KFDA certification.

GAEMI Indoor is ROBOTIS' autonomous service robot for hotels, hospitals, offices and public buildings, delivering items, documents and food between floors via elevator integration, and offering multilingual docent/guidance services with a built-in arm for button presses and item handling.
DS30W is a hydrogen-fuel-cell multicopter drone from Doosan Mobility Innovation, offering up to 120 minutes of flight time with a 3 kg payload for industrial inspection and monitoring missions.
DT30X is a hydrogen-fuel-cell multicopter drone from Doosan Mobility Innovation, extending flight time to 150 minutes with a 5 kg payload capacity for extended industrial missions.
DS035CCD is a hydrogen-fuel-cell multicopter drone in Doosan Mobility Innovation's lineup, rated for 120 minutes of flight time with a 3 kg payload.
DJ25 is Doosan Mobility Innovation's hydrogen-fuel-cell VTOL drone, its longest-endurance model with up to 330 minutes (5.5 hours) of flight time and a 4 kg payload.

Delta MAR (D-Bot MAR) is a Delta Electronics autonomous mobile robot for intralogistics, offering independent navigation without added infrastructure, 360-degree obstacle detection, up to 500 kg payload, +/-5 mm positioning accuracy, up to 1.5 m/s speed, DIN EN ISO 3691-4 safety compliance, and VDA5050 fleet-integration support with wireless or manual charging.

Dynamic Duo is a modular mobile-manipulator system from Delta Electronics pairing one of its D-Bot collaborative arms (payload/reach configurations up to 10 kg) with a battery-powered mobile platform, letting the arm be used stationary or transition to mobile operation for flexible factory floor use.

RICE Delivery is an autonomous indoor delivery robot from Hong Kong-based Rice Robotics, built on the company's RICE platform with a 30 kg payload compartment, 52 kg weight, 22-hour battery life and LiDAR-based navigation for offices, hotels and malls. It has been deployed in Hong Kong and Japan including SoftBank headquarters and Seven-Eleven Japan pilots.

RICE Patrol is a security patrol robot from Hong Kong's Rice Robotics built on the company's RICE platform, fitted with a 360-degree 8K panoramic camera and LiDAR, IR and sonar sensors for autonomous building security rounds.

RICE Disinfection is a vapor-sanitisation robot variant of Rice Robotics' RICE platform, carrying a 20-liter disinfectant tank with a 0.65 L/h vaporisation rate covering 100-130 sq m per cycle; it has been deployed at Hong Kong venues including K11 MUSEA and the HKCEC.

FREE Walk is a powered lower-limb exoskeleton rehabilitation robot from Taiwan's FREE Bionics (an ITRI spin-off backed by Wistron) for spinal-cord-injury and stroke patients to relearn walking. It weighs 20 kg, supports users up to 100 kg and 150-190 cm tall, walks at up to 2 km/h on 3-5 degree slopes, and is designed for quick donning/doffing with tool-free fit adjustment. It has been exported to rehabilitation markets in Japan and Europe.

Bandicoot Mini is GenRobotics' compact, solar-assisted robotic unit for preventive manhole cleaning, built to navigate narrow lanes and perform routine sewer maintenance without human entry. It runs 5-6 hours per charge with about a 10-hour recharge time and is intended for light, non-blocked manholes, with the larger Bandicoot or Bandicoot Mobility+ recommended for heavier blockages. It is made by Genrobotic Innovations Pvt. Ltd. of Thiruvananthapuram, India.

Wilboar is GenRobotics' robotic rover for cleaning and inspecting large horizontal confined spaces such as sewer wells, canals, stormwater drains and STP wells without human entry. It is IP68-rated and carries night-vision cameras for operation in dark, submerged conditions. The first public deployment was a rover for canal and stormwater-drain maintenance at Thiruvananthapuram International Airport in 2024.

G-Mammoth is GenRobotics' all-in-one urban sanitation machine that combines high-pressure jetting, suction, desilting and real-time inspection in a single automated system, replacing multiple separate machines for drain and infrastructure maintenance with zero human entry. It was rolled out to Indian municipal corporations, including Thiruvananthapuram, from 2025.

G-Gaiter is GenRobotics' AI-powered robotic gait trainer and exoskeleton system for patients with gait disabilities from stroke, spinal cord injury, Parkinson's disease or cerebral palsy, using patented G-PLOT pneumatic technology, dynamic bodyweight support and AI-driven therapy modes (passive, assistive, resistive). The Standard model targets adult rehabilitation; GenRobotics also sells Paediatric and Advanced (adult+paediatric) variants. It launched in India in 2022.

G-Gaiter Paediatric is GenRobotics' child-sized robotic gait trainer, engineered with paediatric ergonomics and therapy modes to deliver AI-assisted gait rehabilitation for children with mobility impairments, distinct from the adult-focused G-Gaiter Standard. It was described as India's first paediatric robotic gait trainer and launched around 2025.

MAG1500 Lifter is an autonomous mobile robot from Botsync that picks up and transports payloads up to 1.5 tonnes for material handling in warehouses and production plants, part of the MAG AMR family built on the company's SyncOS fleet software. Botsync is a Singapore-headquartered robotics company with R&D and regional operations in Bangalore, India, serving FMCG, automotive and distribution customers.

MAG1400 Fork is a Botsync autonomous mobile robot fitted with a fork attachment for automated pallet handling, stacking and transport in warehouses and manufacturing facilities, reducing manual forklift operations. It lifts to 1600 mm and is part of Botsync's MAG AMR product line, orchestrated by the company's SyncOS fleet-management software.

MAG1500 AGV Tugger is Botsync's automated guided vehicle for towing trolleys and carts of up to 1500 kg in industrial environments, using magnetic-tape navigation plus LiDAR and mechanical bumpers for safe operation, replacing manual tugger runs on factory floors.

MAG600 Lifter is a smaller-payload autonomous mobile robot in Botsync's MAG lineup, designed to pick up and transport loads of up to 600 kg in warehouses and production plants to cut manual material handling.

UnboxSort is Unbox Robotics' modular, vertical robotic parcel-sortation system that uses a swarm of small autonomous robots working in 3D space to sort parcels by order, route, store or carrier with a reduced warehouse footprint, aimed at e-commerce and urban-logistics fulfilment centres. Unbox Robotics is a Pune, India-based warehouse-automation company.

StarButler is Milagrow's indoor delivery robot for restaurants, hotels, malls and airports, with a 10-inch touchscreen for task instructions and advertising, active obstacle avoidance, automatic navigation and plate-recycling/cruise modes for direct meal delivery.

Novus CARRY-250 is the entry-level model in Hi-Tech Robotic Systemz's (rebranded Novus Hi-Tech) in-house-built Novus Carry AMR family, moving loads up to 250 kg through narrow aisles and tight assembly cells using natural navigation with 3D LiDAR and QR-assist docking. The Gurugram, India company has deployed 1,400+ such robots across manufacturing and warehouse customers.

Novus CARRY-2000 is the heaviest-payload model in Hi-Tech Robotic Systemz's Novus Carry AMR line, built for pallet and heavy-load transport across factories and warehouses, part of a five-class platform (250 kg to 2000 kg) using 3D LiDAR/SLAM navigation and safe mixed-traffic operation alongside human workers.

Daksh is a battery-powered, remotely operated bomb-disposal robot developed by DRDO's Research & Development Establishment (Engineers) with Tata Motors, Theta Controls, Bharat Electronics and Dynalog India. It climbs stairs and slopes, tows objects, uses a robotic arm with portable X-ray to inspect suspect items, and can neutralise bombs with a water-jet disrupter; a shotgun attachment can break open locked doors. The first five units were handed to the Indian Army's Corps of Engineers in December 2011, and lighter Daksh Mini and Daksh Scout variants were later developed for confined-space and rapid-reconnaissance use.

Muntra is DRDO's unmanned, teleoperated/autonomous tracked ground vehicle, developed by the Combat Vehicles Research and Development Establishment (CVRDE) by converting BMP-II armoured vehicles. It comes in three mission variants: Muntra-S for unmanned surveillance, Muntra-M for mine detection and marking, and Muntra-N for reconnaissance in nuclear or biological hazard zones. It was first publicly shown in 2017.

Agri Kisan Drone (GA-AD) is Garuda Aerospace's precision-agriculture spraying drone for uniform application of fertilizers, pesticides and nutrients, with terrain-following and obstacle-detection sensors, flow sensors for controlled spray output and an RGB camera for field mapping. It was the Chennai company's original drone distributed to farmers under India's government-backed 'Drone Didi' / Kisan Drone programmes.

Agri Kisan Drone Medium (GA-AD-M) is Garuda Aerospace's larger-payload precision-spraying drone for medium-to-large farm fields, with a higher rated speed and about 19 minutes of tested flight endurance, alongside terrain-following, obstacle-detection and flow-controlled spraying.

KARMI-Bot is a Kerala-made autonomous hospital robot from Asimov Robotics that navigates isolation wards to deliver food and medical supplies to quarantined patients, supports video-conferencing between patients and remote caregivers, and can disinfect returned items; a KARMI-Clean variant performs large-area UV disinfection. It was deployed in Kerala hospitals during the COVID-19 pandemic from 2020.

SEVABOT is a hospital logistics robot from Asimov Robotics (Kerala, India) that autonomously transports blood samples and ampoules between ICUs and clinical labs, and ferries medicines and consumables between operation theatres, pharmacy stores and ICUs, integrating with existing hospital workflows.

Agricultural picking robot from AUBO Robotics (Beijing), using a collaborative robot-arm system to perform precise, non-damaging automated harvesting in greenhouse farming settings; part of the company's modern-agriculture product line.

Mobile manipulation robot in AUBO Robotics' AMR Hainar series, pairing a dual-wheel differential-drive autonomous base with an optional collaborative arm (AUBO-i5H through i20) for warehouse and industrial material-handling tasks. It weighs 250 kg, carries up to 300 kg including the mounted arm and end-effector, reaches 1.3 m/s, and runs about 6 hours per charge from a 48V 52Ah lithium battery.
